description: This file contains utility functions to parse equations, validate source code expressions, and perform numerical integration methods (Euler and RK4) for differential equations, specifically tailored for equations involving x and y variables with support for common mathematical functions.

methods.name: parseEquationSet(equations)
methods.description: Parses an object containing equations for x and y as strings, validates, and returns functions fx and fy for numerical evaluation.

methods.name: parseSingle(text, varName)
methods.description: Processes an individual equation string, validates its syntax and symbols, and returns a function that computes its numerical value given x, y, t.

methods.name: eulerStep({ x, y, t, dt }, { fx, fy })
methods.description: Performs a single Euler integration step on the (x, y, t) state using provided derivative functions.

methods.name: rk4Step({ x, y, t, dt }, { fx, fy })
methods.description: Performs a single Runge-Kutta 4th order integration step on the (x, y, t) state using provided derivative functions.

ctags.name: eulerStep
ctags.pattern: /^export function eulerStep({ x, y, t, dt }, { fx, fy }) {$/
ctags.signature: ({ x, y, t, dt }, { fx, fy })

ctags.name: rk4Step
ctags.pattern: /^export function rk4Step({ x, y, t, dt }, { fx, fy }) {$/
ctags.signature: ({ x, y, t, dt }, { fx, fy })

ctags.name: x
ctags.pattern: /^    const scope = { x, y, t, pi: Math.PI, e: Math.E, sin: Math.sin, cos: Math.cos, tan: Math.tan/

fields.name: const scope = { x, y, t, pi: Math.PI, e: Math.E, sin: Math.sin, cos: Math.cos, tan: Math.tan/
